official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 1, Agreement between the District and Mar Con Builders, Inc., Oakland, CA, for Project completion and reconciling, with the latter, the remaining contingency for the Elmhurst Middle School Boiler Replacement Project, in the amount of $22,546.00, reducing the Agreement price from $1,238,116.00 to $1,215,570.00, and extending the term from April 25, 2019 thru July 30, 2019 to September 30, 2020.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Cuts $22,546 from Mar Con Builders' Elmhurst Middle boiler job and extends it to September 2020
summary: This change order closes out the Elmhurst Middle School Boiler Replacement Project with Mar Con Builders and returns unused contingency money. It lowers the contract price by $22,546.00, from $1,238,116.00 to $1,215,570.00. It also extends the end date from July 30, 2019 to September 30, 2020.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
